title: Dependency Ordering
description: Given a set of tasks and prerequisite relationships, determine whether all tasks can be completed. If possible, print one valid ordering of all tasks; otherwise print -1.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; 0 <= m <= 200000; tasks are numbered from 0 to n-1.
inputFormat: First line: n and m. Next m lines contain a and b, meaning task a must be completed before task b.
outputFormat: Print a valid task ordering separated by spaces, or -1 if the dependency graph contains a cycle.
hints: Use indegrees and repeatedly process tasks whose prerequisite count becomes zero.

examples.explanation: Task 0 comes before tasks 1 and 2, and task 1 comes before task 3.
The dependencies form a cycle, so no valid ordering exists.
